voices.label: BD
voices.name: Bass Drum
controls: no per-voice controls (global VOLUME, TEMPO, TONE and ACCENT level knobs only)
voices.notes: Programmable per step in step write (START = hit, STOP = rest). Abbreviation as given by polynominal; printed panel legend not verified.

voices.label: SD
voices.name: Snare Drum
controls: no per-voice controls (global VOLUME, TEMPO, TONE and ACCENT level knobs only)
voices.notes: Programmable per step.

voices.label: RS
voices.name: Rim Shot
controls: no per-voice controls (global VOLUME, TEMPO, TONE and ACCENT level knobs only)
voices.notes: Programmable per step; whether it shares circuitry with SD is unknown.

voices.label: HH
voices.name: Hi-Hat (closed only)
controls: HI-HAT switch: off / 8th notes / 16th notes (polynominal also lists 12ths); not programmable per step
voices.notes: Free-running straight hat pattern set by a switch; no open hat; no shuffle.

accent: Accent is written per step in step-write mode and emphasises every sound on that step; one global ACCENT level knob sets the amount; the CSQ jack outputs a pulse on each accented step.
global_features: 8 user pattern memories: patterns 1-6 have 16 steps, 7-8 have 12 steps (3/4, 6/8); VARIATION A / B (A+B gives up to 32 steps / 2 bars)
no factory preset patterns documented; no song chaining; tempo not stored with patterns
TONE knob: global dark-to-bright filter (Bonedo, polynominal); MusicTech says it mainly tames the hi-hat
no balance control, no per-voice level, tuning or decay, no flam, no shuffle
jacks: mono output, footswitch start/stop, DBS sync out (one pulse per step), CSQ out (one pulse per accented step); no sync input
battery powered; release year conflicts: 1979 (Bonedo), 1980 (Vintage Synth Explorer), 1981 (polynominal)
pack_contents: 'Boss DR-55': 17 stereo 16-bit/44.1 kHz WAV one-shots (longest 0.94 s), named not numbered: Bassdrum-01/02, Snaredrum-01,02,03,05,06,07,08,09 (no -04), Hihat1/2, Rimshot, plus a second set DR-55Kick, DR-55Snare, DR-55Hat, DR-55Pop ('Pop' unidentified). 'DR55': 4 mono WAV one-shots, all <=0.084 s (possibly truncated): dr55_bd, dr55_sn, dr55_rim, dr55_ch. No loops, MIDI or docs. The multiple kick/snare takes probably reflect different TONE/ACCENT settings (inferred).

voices.label: SNARE DRUM
voices.name: Snare Drum
controls: no per-voice level, tuning or decay
BALANCE knob (5-0-5) shifts bass+snare against hi-hats+cymbal (side of HAND CLAP unknown)
voices.notes: BALANCE 'drums' side.

voices.label: O.HIHAT
voices.name: Open Hi-Hat
controls: no per-voice level, tuning or decay
BALANCE knob (5-0-5) shifts bass+snare against hi-hats+cymbal (side of HAND CLAP unknown)
voices.notes: Made from the cymbal generator's 'High Metal' signal; its decay is cut off by C.HIHAT (Electric Druid). Manual notation also uses 'Closed & Open Hihat' on one step.

voices.label: C.HIHAT
voices.name: Closed Hi-Hat
controls: no per-voice level, tuning or decay
BALANCE knob (5-0-5) shifts bass+snare against hi-hats+cymbal (side of HAND CLAP unknown)
voices.notes: Shuts off the open hat's decay (Electric Druid).

voices.label: CYMBAL
voices.name: Cymbal
controls: no per-voice level, tuning or decay
BALANCE knob (5-0-5) shifts bass+snare against hi-hats+cymbal (side of HAND CLAP unknown)
voices.notes: Attack from 'High Metal', tail from 'Low Metal' (Electric Druid); shares the AC/CY/HCP display row.

voices.label: HAND CLAP
voices.name: Hand Clap
controls: no per-voice level, tuning or decay
BALANCE knob (5-0-5) shifts bass+snare against hi-hats+cymbal (side of HAND CLAP unknown)
voices.notes: Shares the AC/CY/HCP display row.

accent: The ACCENT instrument key (leftmost) writes a per-step accent; the ACCENT knob (0-10) sets its depth; the accent trigger drives a short envelope on the overall output VCA, so every sound on that step gets louder (Electric Druid). An ACC TRIG OUT jack is provided 'for controlling a synthesizer' (presumably fires on accented steps - inferred).
global_features: 16 preset patterns in banks C and D (C-1..C-8, D-1..D-8) + 16 user patterns in banks A and B
12/16 key: 16 or 12 steps per pattern for triplets / triple time
STEP WRITE and TAP (real-time) WRITE; LCD step-grid display
2 songs of up to 128 measures each
TEMPO knob 45-300 BPM (Wikipedia)
OUTPUT (P-BUS) and headphone jacks; mono mix, no individual outputs, no panning
no flam, no shuffle control, no per-voice tuning or decay
AC adaptor (BOSS PSA) or battery; memory backup
pack_contents: 'Boss DR-110': 13 stereo 16-bit/44.1 kHz WAV one-shots (longest 1.6 s), named: Bassdrum, Snaredrum, Hat Closed, Hat Open, Crash, Ride, Clap plus DR-110Kick, DR-110Snare, DR-110Hat_C, DR-110Hat_O, DR-110Cymbal, DR-110Clap. built_in_effects.name: Reverb/Delay
built_in_effects.notes: REV/DLY TYPE: Small Room, Studio, Club, Lounge, Large Hall, Dark Hall, Plate 1, Plate 2 (reverbs), Stereo Delay, Pan Delay (delays); reverb time 0-100, reverb level 0-127; delay time 5-450 ms or tempo note values (not synced to external MIDI clock), delay level 0-100, feedback 0-127. built_in_effects.name: Flanger
built_in_effects.notes: Jet, Soft, Hard or Cold flanger; rate 0-100; level 0-127; fed by each instrument's FLANGER SEND (0-100); front-panel FLANGER knob.

built_in_effects.name: LOW knob
built_in_effects.notes: Front-panel LOW knob marked cut/boost (manual item 2, p.16; detailed behaviour not read).

global_features: 24-voice polyphony (some instruments use 2 voices)
kit = 13 drum instruments + 1 bass part (+ external MIDI part); 128 preset kits P000-P127 + 64 user kits
400 preset patterns in 11 styles + 100 user patterns; patterns 1-8 measures, beat 1/4-4/4
Realtime Modify knobs CUTOFF / RESONANCE / DECAY with INSTRUMENT SELECT (one instrument, ALL DRUMS, ALL INST)
ROLL: 68 roll types (incl. Flam 1-3, Fill 1-8, Phrase 1-12), speed 0-127; rolls on MIDI notes 100-112

Groove Quantize: 20 templates (8Beat/16Beat Hi-Accent, Lo-Swing, Hi-Swing; Rhumba, Fusion, Reggae 1-3; Samba; Salsa; Triplets; Lagging Triplets; Sextuplets); grid quantize down to 32nd-note triplets; Timing Shift
tempo 40.0-250.0 BPM, tap tempo; recommended tempo stored per pattern
MUTE and SOLO per instrument; footswitch assignable to start/stop or any pad
MIDI IN/OUT; drum part on channel 10 by default; Bank Select MSB 81 = preset kits, 85 = user kits

accent: Hold ACC while writing (or while tapping a pad) to accent that step; each pad's ACCENT FOLLOW (-7..+7, factory +7) is added to its LEVEL (0-15) for accented hits; putting one sound on several pads with different Level/Accent Follow gives up to 22 accent levels. Accent cannot be recorded as velocity.
global_features: 48 16-bit PCM sounds; 12-voice polyphony; MIDI chart dated Nov 1, 1989
4 pad banks (A-D) x 12 pads; factory Tone Color and Decay 0, Accent Follow 7
64 preset patterns (pattern bank B, numbers 11-88) + 64 programmable patterns (bank A)
Scale (shortest note per step): 32nd note, 16th-note triplet, 16th note, 8th-note triplet; Last Step 1-16 sets the pattern length (odd meters)
step write and real-time write; 8 songs x 160 measures; song chain up to 1,280 measures; 6 demo songs
tempo 40-250 BPM; minimum resolution a 32nd note
MIDI IN only (notes, Song Select 0-7, clock); cassette tape save/load; stereo out R / L(MONO) + headphones; 6 x AA batteries or BOSS PSA adaptor
no flam, shuffle or per-pad tuning; no effects

pack_contents: 'Boss DR-550': 92 mono 16-bit/44.1 kHz WAV one-shots (longest 3.6 s). Top level: 45 'DR550...' files - Kick01-05, Snare01-05, Rim, Clap01-02, Hat01_C/O, Hat02_C/O, Hat03_C/O, Tom01_Hi/M/Lo, Tom02_Hi/M/Lo, TomE, Crash01, Ride01-02, SplashCym, Cowbell, Clave, Conga_Hi/M/Lo, Bongo_Hi/Lo, AgogoHi/Lo, Timbale, Tamborine, Maracas, HiQ, Scratch01-02. Subfolders (47 files): Bassdrums/ Bassdrum-01..05; Snaredrums/ Snaredrum-01..06 + Rim Shot; Toms/ Tom H-01..03, Tom M-01..02, Tom L-01..03; Cymbals/ Crash, Ride-01..02, Hat Closed-01..02, Hat Open-01..02; Percussion/ Agogo H/L, Bongo H/L, Cabasa-01..02, Clap, Claves, Conga H/L/S, Cowbell-01..02, Hi Q, 'Srcatch'-01..02 [sic], Tambourine, Timbale H/L, Whistle. The subfolders closely match the Mk I 48-sound list (PHH1 pedal hat missing; SHKr unclear). The top-level set includes Maracas, Clap02 and a third hat pair (MKII-only sounds) plus a splash cymbal (in neither list), so its origin is unclear (inferred). No loops or MIDI.

accent: No accent button documented; dynamics come from the 16 velocity- and aftertouch-sensitive pads (aftertouch varies roll volume). The velocity curve CRV (EXP1, LIN1, EXP2, LIN2, XFDO, XFDI, FIX1, FIX2) is set per pad bank; XFDI/XFDO crossfade Pad Bank A and B layers by velocity. The 23 MIDI-only sounds cannot be recorded into patterns (MT 1992).

built_in_effects.name: Reverb
built_in_effects.notes: R.TYPE HALL / ROOM / PLATE / DELAY / PAN-DLY; R.TIME 0-31; R.LPF (pre low-pass) 0-7; D.FDBK 0-15 for DELAY/PAN-DLY; per-instrument reverb depth plus overall depth, stored per kit; never on the INDIVIDUAL outputs (dry); MT 1992: reverb cannot run together with Out 1.

built_in_effects.name: Chorus
built_in_effects.notes: C.TYPE CHORUS or FLANGER; C.DPTH 0-15; C.RATE 0-15; per-instrument chorus depth plus overall depth, stored per kit; MT 1992: chorus cannot run together with Out 2.

global_features: 255 16-bit PCM sounds (0-254, 255 = OFF); 12-voice polyphony
Drum Kit = 55 sounds: Pad Bank A (16) + Pad Bank B (16) + 23 MIDI-only notes; MIDI notes 27-81 on a General-MIDI-style map
7 preset kits (0-6) + 32 user kits (7-38); factory user kits include TR808, TR909, Jazz, Brush, Dance, Perc, FX, SlapBs, Syn Bs and layer kits
Pad Bank Layer (A+B) with velocity crossfade curves
FLAM button (interval and balance editable) and ROLL button (speed editable)
100 preset patterns (25 styles x Original / Fill in to Variation / Variation / Fill in to Original) + 150 user patterns; 100 songs (250 parts each, 900 total); Realtime Pattern Change
96 ppqn; quantize; swing; timing shift; tempo 20-260
outputs: stereo L(MONO)/R, INDIVIDUAL 1 and 2 (dry), headphones; MIDI IN/OUT; SysEx bulk dump
